title: Composer Repository Package Loading Flow
interaction_flow: Caller → ComposerRepository: loadPackages(packageNameMap, acceptableStabilities, stabilityFlags, alreadyLoaded)
ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: hasProviders() [triggers loadRootServerFile()]
ComposerRepository → Cache: read('packages.json')
alt Cache hit and fresh: ComposerRepository uses cached $data directly
alt Cache hit with last-modified: ComposerRepository → HttpDownloader: GET packages.json with If-Modified-Since header
alt No cache: ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: fetchFile(getPackagesJsonUrl(), 'packages.json', null, true)
ComposerRepository → EventDispatcher: dispatch(PRE_FILE_DOWNLOAD, PreFileDownloadEvent)
ComposerRepository → HttpDownloader: get(url, options) → Response
ComposerRepository: verify sha256 checksum (retry up to 3x on mismatch, throw RepositorySecurityException)
ComposerRepository → EventDispatcher: dispatch(POST_FILE_DOWNLOAD, PostFileDownloadEvent)
ComposerRepository → Cache: write('packages.json', json) with last-modified
loadRootServerFile sets: lazyProvidersUrl (metadata-url = V2), providersUrl (V1), hasProviders, availablePackages/availablePackagePatterns
alt V1 providers path (hasProviders=true): ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: whatProvides(name, stabilities, flags)
ComposerRepository: check providerListing for sha256 hash
ComposerRepository → Cache: sha256(cacheKey) == hash? → read from cache
or: ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: fetchFile(providerUrl, cacheKey, hash)
ComposerRepository → StabilityFilter: isPackageAcceptable(stabilities, flags, names, stability)
ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: createPackages(versionsToLoad, packagesSource) → ArrayLoader.load()
ComposerRepository: setRepository(this) on each package; handle AliasPackage (also set aliased package)
alt V2 lazyProviders path: ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: loadAsyncPackages(packageNameMap, stabilities, flags)
ComposerRepository: add ~dev variant per package name if dev stability acceptable
loop for each package name:
ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: startCachedAsyncDownload(name, realName) → PromiseInterface
ComposerRepository → Cache: read(provider-{name}.json) for lastModified
ComposerRepository → ComposerRepository: asyncFetchFile(url, cacheKey, lastModified) → PromiseInterface
ComposerRepository: check freshMetadataUrls (skip if already fresh → resolve(true))
ComposerRepository: check packagesNotFoundCache (skip if 404'd → resolve(['packages'=>[]]))
ComposerRepository → EventDispatcher: dispatch(PRE_FILE_DOWNLOAD)
ComposerRepository → HttpDownloader: async GET url (with If-Modified-Since if lastModified)
HttpDownloader → ComposerRepository: Response (200 / 304 / 404)
on 304: ComposerRepository marks freshMetadataUrls[url]=true, returns true (use cache)
on 404: ComposerRepository marks packagesNotFoundCache[url]=true, returns ['packages'=>[]]
on 200: ComposerRepository → EventDispatcher: dispatch(POST_FILE_DOWNLOAD); Cache::write(cacheKey, json)
Promise.then: if minified ('composer/2.0') → MetadataMinifier: expand(versions)
Promise.then: foreach version → StabilityFilter: isVersionAcceptable(constraint, name, version, stabilities, flags)
Promise.then: ComposerRepository → ArrayLoader: load(versionData) → PackageInterface
Promise.then: setRepository(this) on package and (if AliasPackage) on aliasOf
ComposerRepository → Loop: wait(promises) [blocks until all async downloads complete]
ComposerRepository → Caller: return ['namesFound' => [...], 'packages' => [...PackageInterface]]
alt no providers/no lazyProvidersUrl: ComposerRepository → ArrayRepository: parent::loadPackages() [iterates in-memory array, checks StabilityFilter + Constraint, handles AliasPackage]
key_relationships: ComposerRepository composes Cache (disk cache for packages.json and provider files)
ComposerRepository composes Loop (React async promise executor)
ComposerRepository composes ArrayLoader (deserializes raw version arrays → PackageInterface)
ComposerRepository depends_on EventDispatcher (optional, for pre/post download events)
ComposerRepository depends_on MetadataMinifier (static: expand minified v2 metadata)
AliasPackage wraps PackageInterface (getAliasOf() returns the real package)
important_notes: V1 protocol: uses providers-url with sha256 hash verification per provider file; synchronous fetchFile()
V2 protocol: uses metadata-url (%package% token), supports async loading via React Promises + Loop::wait()
V2 async uses If-Modified-Since / 304 caching; freshMetadataUrls avoids redundant re-fetches in same run
sha256 mismatch on fetchFile triggers up to 3 retries, then throws RepositorySecurityException (MITM protection)
loadRootServerFile() is lazy (guarded by $this->rootData != null) but called from hasProviders() before loadPackages logic
AliasPackage handling: both the alias and the aliased real package get setRepository(); aliases of matched packages included even without direct constraint match
Partial packages: root packages.json may embed inline package data (hasPartialPackages=true), bypassing network fetch for those names
initialize() (called lazily for in-memory use): calls loadDataFromServer() → createPackages() → addPackage() for all packages
